rows.en: the Zeon raid on the Alex was six days past.
rows.note: Continues S01827 (prev slice, 'later called Operation Rubicon,'). Cut so S01827 can read e.g. 'Later to be called Operation Rubicon,' + this row; orchestrator should check the join.

rows.en: While the town celebrated Christmas,
a Zeon mobile suit once again
attacked the base.
rows.note: 'base' moved from S01830 to fit English word order.

rows.en: With no defense forces, the Federation
had no choice but to send out the Alex again.
Strangely enough, this attack
came from a single Zaku, but...
Konpeito Area
rows.note: Game's own English subtitle, kept as written (glossary form for the place is 'Konpei Island').

rows.en: Universal Century 0083, November 10.
At Konpei Island, formerly Solomon,
as the EFF's Naval Review
rows.note: EFF short form (glossary) to keep the line narrow.

rows.en: was about to begin,
Zeon remnant mobile suits,
bound to join the Delaz Fleet,
were appearing one by one around Solomon.
Wary of this suspicious activity,
still hunting the stolen Gundam GP02,
rows.note: 'still' added for flow (the search is ongoing); GP02 per terms.json 'Gundam GP02'.

rows.en: the Albion team, too,
was on sweep duty in the same sector.
And there appeared...
As the Federation Forces' Naval Review neared,
in the space around Solomon,
the main force of the Zeon remnant
rows.note: 'main force' moved up from S01853 for English order.

rows.en: "Delaz Fleet"
was gathering.
The mission of Anavel Gato, one of its own,
was to attack the Naval Review.
Stolen by his own hand from the Federation,
the "Gundam GP02" would
unleash its nuclear warhead...
rows.note: S01857-59 is an inverted afterthought in JP ('with the nuclear warhead of the GP02 he stole himself...'); recast as one sentence, trailing '...' kept.

rows.en: Act One of "Operation Stardust" had begun.
On the Earth orbit
rows.note: Game's own English subtitle, kept as written (shared by 14 intros).

rows.en: The Delaz Fleet's "Operation Stardust."
Its ultimate aim was to drop a colony
onto the Earth.
Doing all they could to stop it,
the Albion team fought on, but
the colony finally passed the point of no return
rows.note: Shared by 8303 (after S01866 '...but') and 8304 (after S01878 '...and'); worded to follow both. No trailing comma since S01868/S01879 begin with 'and'.

rows.en: and began to be drawn toward the Earth.
With Cima Garahau's fleet
defecting to the Federation,
the Solar System II struck the colony,
but with too little power,
the colony did not break apart
and kept on moving.
The fight now turns to the Solar System's second shot...
The battle with no victor goes on.
Despite every effort to stop it,
the Albion team was held off by Gato, and
rows.note: JP: 'partly thanks to Gato intercepting the Albion team, which strove to stop it'; recast so shared S01867 can follow.

rows.en: and entered a falling orbit toward Earth.
The game-changer, Solar System II,
rows.note: 'gyakuten no saku' = the plan to turn the tables.

rows.en: struck the colony, but
with too little power, the colony
did not break apart and kept on moving.
Through the Delaz Fleet's desperate
"Operation Stardust,"
the colony began its fall to Earth.
Choosing this very moment, Cima
swiftly took Supreme Commander Delaz hostage.
To defect to the Federation,
she had planned to hand Delaz over.
rows.note: 'Delaz' moved from S01889 for English order. Cima female per glossary.

rows.en: After years of neglect and bitterness in Zeon,
this was, for Cima,
the gamble of a lifetime.
But in a sudden reversal, Delaz killed himself,
and Gato destroyed the Gwaden's bridge.
Cima had narrowly managed to escape,
rows.note: Name moved up from S01897 so the sentence reads naturally.

rows.en: but even so,
the gears of her plan had begun to slip...
Frontier I
rows.note: Game's own English subtitle; roman numeral converted to ASCII.

rows.en: Universal Century 0123.
Far from Earth, the new space colonies of
Frontier Side
were suddenly attacked by unknown mobile suits.
rows.note: JP is a noun phrase ('the mysterious MS unit that suddenly attacked...'); recast as a clause. 47 chars vs 16 JP chars - may be wide; 'MS' is a fallback abbreviation.

rows.en: Seabook, a civilian boy,
escaped the colony with his friends, but
along the way, his girlfriend
rows.note: Continues into S01908-09 (next slice: 'Cecily Fairchild' / 'became separated'); next slice should read e.g. 'Cecily Fairchild' + 'was separated from him.'

decisions: Narration in past tense throughout, except S01875-76 (JP closing present-tense lines kept present).
Where JP word order forces it, a word moves to the neighbouring row of the same sentence (noted per row); no rows merged or split, trailing '...' kept.
Bracketed JP terms (Operation Stardust, Delaz Fleet, Gundam GP02) kept in double quotes where the JP brackets them.
Full-width English subtitles (S01837, S01861, S01900) kept as the game's own wording, converted to ASCII.
uncertain: S01828: join with S01827 (prev slice) depends on how that row was cut; I wrote 'the Zeon raid on the Alex was six days past.'
S01837/S01839: subtitle says 'Konpeito Area' (kept), narration uses glossary 'Konpei Island' - mismatch on screen.
S01867: 'point of no return' for sokushi genkaiten (literally 'interception limit point'); not in glossary.
S01888: 'Supreme Commander' for Delaz from glossary entry marked unverified.
S01895: 'Gwaden' (Delaz's flagship) not in glossary; used Gundam Wiki spelling.
S01907: cut assumes next slice puts Cecily Fairchild as the subject of 'became separated'.
